rules: A set is frozen by `course_eval_grading.py freeze` once its baseline is scored and committed. After that its rows and bank never change: a new or corrected row goes into a new version (quiz-grading-v2.jsonl, registered here), and the old results keep their meaning.

quiz-grading-v1.notes: Hand-written seed rows. Persona rows from course_eval_personas.py join after a person reviews them, before the baseline; then the set is frozen.
